title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Request To Modify List of Taxable Substances; Notice of Filing for Neo Decanoic Acid
action: Notice of filing and request for comments.
abstract: This notice of filing announces that a petition has been filed requesting that neo decanoic acid be added to the list of taxable substances. This notice of filing also requests comments on the petition. This notice of filing is not a determination that the list of taxable substances is modified.
